<!-- Reference: DELTARUNE -->
Some deer women may [[like]] tyrannosaurus women for their ''purple scales'', ''sharp teeth'', and ''tails''. This is strange, as a tyrannosaurus woman would deny that she even has a tail.

<!-- Reference: Barney the Dinosaur -->
[[Human]] [[children]] have expressed critical reception over a purple tyrannosaurus man whose appearance is vastly less threatening and welcoming than what's normally seen in-game. This creature is famous for teaching child-friendly and warmhearted lessons, as well as expressing his love for everyone. Although popular with children, he is heavily mocked and parodied by adults. He is often seen accompanied by a green [[triceratops man|triceratops woman]], a yellow, [[Armor#Headgear|cap]]-wearing [[microceratus man]], and an orange [[parasaurolophus man]].
